supersedes: renal-spatial-v05-20261014 (registered; first application of the method, pooled result pending at drafting). v0.6 changes how a frozen hypothesis is judged, not what is searched: (1) relation v06 -- one ridge over [comparison | hypothesis block] with separate penalties for the two blocks chosen jointly by patient-grouped inner CV, so a wide comparison model can no longer shrink a real 2 % hypothesis to zero gain (Agent L, on Agent Q's benchmark worlds); (2) the nested explanation ladder N, B1, B2, B3 is the pass structure inside the registered run: every frozen hypothesis is validated at every level with its own held-out CI, held-out R2 and nulls, and reported with a tier, none dropped (owner review 2026-10-14; Agent D's levels); (3) the residual-bank generator (one head per level) is a planned proposer; (4) the molecular x crude-context family is withdrawn pending composition-preserving architecture search.

discovery.candidate_budget_meaning: frozen candidates per relationship family entering the ledger at 'proposed' after the fold sweep; raw per-target proposals are internal search and recorded with their cost
discovery.outer_split: five grouped patient folds over the 24 HEST ccRCC patients (1 sample = 1 patient), deterministic shuffle with fold_seed; each fold in turn is D_R, the other four are D_P; HVG selection, z-score statistics, PCA of image embeddings and program ranking are fit on D_P only

targets.definition_rule: every response is response-free defined, within-patient centred, and never derived from a gene set under test

morphology.morph_pc1: H-optimus per-spot embedding PC 1, PCA fit on D_P, patient-residualised
morphology.cv_count: CellViT nuclei assigned to the spot (nearest-spot assignment, radius = spot_diameter_fullres / 2), log1p
morphology.cv_area: mean nuclear polygon area of the spot's nuclei
morphology.cv_frac_Neoplastic: fraction of the spot's nuclei in CellViT class Neoplastic

spatial_organisation.nbr_mp1..nbr_mp8: neighbour-mean (k=6, within sample) of the 8 Gavish malignant metaprogram scores with the highest within-patient Moran's I on D_P; program identities recorded per fold in the receipt

discovery.candidate_variables: the D_P-selected 300 highest-variance genes (log-CPM, patient fixed effect removed, z-scored with D_P statistics) and, for the morpheus_factorized arm, its representation coordinates mapped back to genes by response-free observed-coordinate links

always: the 41 Gavish program scores of the spot
when_order_ge_3: all pairwise products of the candidate's variables
competitor_set.rule: the simpler model is fit on D_P and frozen; gain = R2(simpler + candidate feature, D_R) - R2(simpler, D_R)
competitor_set.exclusion_clause: the simpler model never contains the response or a deterministic function of it: for cv_frac_<class> targets all CellViT class fractions are excluded from the baseline (they sum to one); for nbr_mp<k> targets the target program's own neighbour mean is excluded (the other 40 neighbour-mean programs and the spot's own 41 program scores remain); receipts record the baseline column names
competitor_set.centring_rule: every competitor column is within-patient STANDARDISED (within sample for spatial contexts): minus the within-patient mean, divided by the within-patient sd of that column's own values (floored), exactly as the response is; the competitor is fit on D_P and frozen; implemented in the substrate (hest.real_episode / bmmc.real_episode, within_patient_scale=True), recorded as metadata.baseline_standardised. Reason: the v0.3 competitor was uncentred (did not transfer); a centred-only competitor still failed morph_pc1 on fold 0 (held-out R2 -0.28 to -0.51) because the within-patient spread of the response differed 3.4x across held-out patients.
competitor_set.library: validation: ridge on the standardised competitor columns with regularisation chosen by patient-grouped inner cross-validation on D_P over a fixed alpha grid that includes the zero (fold-mean) model; the full model (competitor + hypothesis feature) is selected the same way, independently; chosen alphas and both held-out R2 values recorded per row. The generator's conventional-explanation step uses ridge / spline-GAM / gradient boosting chosen on inner patient folds (never on D_R). A fold where the competitor itself is below zero on held-out patients is a fold where a hypothesis must still clear full-model R2 > 0; no other rule.
morphology_targets: CellViT class fractions (except for the matching class's own density target: cv_count and that class fraction excluded)
neighbour means (k=6 and k=18) of the 91 programme scores and of the 50 own-spot PCA columns
own_mp_targets: the other Gavish programmes + 50 Hallmark own-spot scores
(no neighbour means; the target's own neighbour mean is excluded everywhere)
competitor_set.standardisation_note: bank columns with within-patient sd < 0.01 on proposal rows are dropped before standardisation (count per view in bank_report)

null_suite.spatial_block: within-patient 2D block swap (6x6 grid) of the response on D_R (destroys spatial organisation, keeps marginals)
null_suite.within_patient_perm: permutation of the response within patient on D_R
null_suite.interaction_break: for |S| >= 2, within-patient block swap of one constituent variable on D_R (breaks joint structure, keeps marginals)

advance_rule.proposed: per relationship family: every hypothesis whose pooled tier is not 'none', ordered by tier (irreducible, partly absorbed, simple association) then by pooled gain at its highest passing level, up to the family budget; provenance kept; every frozen hypothesis is reported with its pooled tier
advance_rule.internal: pooled tier irreducible or partly absorbed, every required B3 structured null (null_suite.required_for_internal) pooled p <= 0.05, and BH q <= 0.10 within family over the frozen set on the worst pooled B3 required-null p; simple associations (novelty unchecked) are reported as discoveries of their own tier and enter the ledger at 'proposed'; tier 'none' hypotheses are reported in funnel_aggregate.json's ladder block; nothing is dropped
advance_rule.external: CPTAC ccRCC tumours only (n=110, canonical protein isoforms, dedupe_symbols): bulk-RNA transfer of the frozen feature vs the programme analogue or slide H&E descriptors; scale extension, same sign, permutation p <= 0.05
advance_rule.orthogonal: CPTAC proteomics transfer, same sign, p <= 0.05
advance_rule.actionable: pre-registered survival spec (hashed before fitting; CPTAC OS, TCGA-KIRC OS; Cox on tertiles with age/sex/stage[/grade]), translational evidence record (Open Targets, DepMap, drugs, safety, biomarker stage), EIG-ranked discriminating experiment
advance_rule.explanation_level: every internal candidate is decomposed (decompose_explanation): A simple / B additive / C non-additive / D context-dependent; no candidate is dropped for being Level A; E/F only from external evidence flags
advance_rule.passing_fold: per ladder level, discovery.ladder.pass_rule; the runner's row-level 'validated' keeps its v0.5 meaning at B3 (held-out full-model R2 > 0 and gain CI > 0) for continuity; the ladder block is the registered pass structure
advance_rule.per_patient_concentration: reported per hypothesis (share of weighted gain carried by the top held-out patient per fold); a flag, never a gate

stop_rules: a family with no internal candidate at budget 50: every hypothesis logged with stop_reason and proposer; report honestly; the advance rule never changes post hoc
all survivors labelled known by the novelty tool after reading the hits: report as independent replication; no novelty claim
sign reversal on any external transfer: candidate stops at internal; hash stays locked

proposers.enumeration: single bank variables and low-order products from the candidate views (unchanged)
proposers.residual_bank: PLANNED (Agent G, morpheus_encoder.residual_bank_generator): one network over the protected views with shared sparse towers + bilinear layer and one head per ladder level, trained on the cross-fitted residual bank r(k) = y - f_k(B_k) of the proposal patients; nominates a hypothesis for a large total effect (head N), for surviving stronger explanations (heads B1..B3), or both; runner name --proposer residual_bank (fails with a clear message if the module is absent)
proposers.rule: enumeration, residual_generator and residual_bank share the per-target budget under --proposer all (discovery.proposers_in_all): each emits up to proposals_per_target hypotheses (equal budgets, as in the benchmark), duplicates merge, and the top proposals_per_target by patient-grouped cross-validated proposal gain on proposal rows are frozen; residual_bank keeps only hypotheses that satisfy a family's context requirement (emitted / admissible counts in proposer_report); --proposer residual_bank alone is a development mode

measurement_bank.response_free_exclusions: per target, as implemented in measurement_bank.build_bank: morph_pc* drop the hoptimus view; cv_count/cv_area drop the matching nuclear column; cv_frac_* drop all class fractions and entropy; nbr_mp* drop that programme's neighbour mean
measurement_bank.caveat: scimilarity and scgpt are pseudo-bulk spot embeddings on Visium; recorded in every view
measurement_bank.coordinate_identity: PCA/NMF components are matched to fold 0's fit by maximum |correlation| of loadings with sign flip and named by the matched index (match |r| recorded; |r| < 0.6 suffixed _unmatched); SCimilarity, scGPT and H-Optimus-0 indices are fixed embeddings

discovery.rows: every v0.4 episode is coverage-complete: spots with H-Optimus-0, CellViT geometry and tissue structure all present; the kept fraction is recorded per fold and target; nothing is imputed
discovery.response_transform: every response is within-patient standardised (mean 0, sd 1 per patient on its own values); recorded as metadata.response_standardised
discovery.relation_note: one ridge over [comparison | hypothesis block] with two penalties: comparison grid 1e2..1e6 or the zero model, block grid 1..1e4 or the zero model, the pair chosen jointly by patient-grouped 5-fold inner CV on proposal rows (6 x 6 grid); the block is the random-feature map + linear constituents (+ pairwise products for k >= 3); the competitor is the same fit with the simpler block (one variable: the comparison model alone with its own penalty, as in v05); every receipt records both penalties, gain_linear / gain_nonlinear_beyond_linear (k = 1) or gain_linear_additive (k >= 2) with patient-bootstrap CIs, and the shape label. A model whose hypothesis block is chosen at the zero model contributes nothing and predicts as its comparison (full model -> the competitor: gain, CI and nulls exactly 0 / 1; competitor or linear model -> the comparison model alone), so no gain can come from a comparison penalty shifted by the pair search. v06_offset is a development check only.
discovery.substrate_note: hest.real_episode(substrate_version='v05', bank=True): morphology competitor = depth, class fractions, 41 Gavish + 50 Hallmark own-spot, neighbour means k=6 and k=18 of the 91 programmes and PCA1-50 (378 columns on fold 0); own_mp competitor = depth, fractions, other 40 Gavish, 50 Hallmark (95); leak guard drops bank columns with within-patient |r| >= 0.9 to the target programme's own k=6 neighbour mean (fold 0: EMT hallmark for own:EMT-I r 0.924; IFN-alpha/gamma hallmarks for own:IFN/MHC-II(I) r 0.928/0.930); near-constant columns (within-patient sd < 0.01) dropped before standardisation (fold 0: SCimilarity 91/128, scGPT 270/512, NMF 8/20, CellViT 2/15); PCA/NMF matched to the fold-0 reference by |r| of loadings with sign flip (<0.6 named _unmatched); fold-0 competitor-alone held-out R2 v0.4 -> v0.5: morph_pc3 0.296 -> 0.252, morph_pc4 0.409 -> 0.391, cv_count 0.079 -> 0.129, own_mp1 0.361 -> 0.433, own_mp2 0.347 -> 0.402

ladder.level_definition: dbench.decomposition.ladder_levels on the registered comparison model's column names (identical to the decomposition_ladder script by construction): N = log1p depth (patient removed by within-patient standardisation of response and columns; the bank has no spot RNA-quality column); B1 = N + CellViT class fractions; B2 = B1 + 41 Gavish + 50 Hallmark own-spot programme scores; B3 = B2 + neighbour means (k = 6, 18) of the programmes and PCA and every other registered comparison column = the full v0.5 comparison model. The v0.5 exclusion clauses carry into every level.
ladder.gain: Delta_k = R2(full model with B_k + H, held-out patients) - R2(competitor with B_k, held-out patients), both fit on proposal patients under relation v06 with B_k as the comparison block
ladder.nulls_note: interaction_break applies to products only (as v0.5); B3 reuses the row's own registered nulls when its draws equal null_suite.draws
ladder.pass_rule_text: a level passes in a fold when the held-out gain's patient-bootstrap CI lies above 0, the full model's held-out R2 > 0 and the within-patient permutation null p <= 0.05
ladder.tiers_note: first matching rule wins; a hypothesis matching none is reported with tier 'none'; no hypothesis is dropped. B1 and B2 do not gate a tier: they name the absorbing step (composition or known programmes). A B3 pass without an N pass is reported as resolved_only_after_adjustment. Flags carried beside the tier, never gates: target_programme_overlap (programme targets, >= 20 % shared genes) and leak_guarded_in_v05 (own_mp targets, within-patient |r| >= 0.9 to the target's own k=6 neighbour mean).
ladder.pooling: registered rule: per hypothesis and level, pooled out-of-fold Delta_k -- each fold's held-out patients are predicted once, the folds' out-of-fold predictions are stacked and Delta_k = R2(full) - R2(competitor) on the stack -- with a CI from a bootstrap over whole held-out patients (as dbench.scripts.decomposition_ladder pool; dbench.decomposition.pool_folds); every null is pooled the same way (draw b's pooled gain = sum over folds of fold null gain x fold SST / pooled SST); a level passes when pooled CI > 0, pooled full-model R2 > 0 and pooled within-patient permutation p <= 0.05; the hypothesis tier follows ladder.tiers on the pooled passes; the folds passing at each level (v0.5 convention >= 3 of 5) are reported beside the tier and never gate; pooling covers the folds in which the hypothesis was frozen (n_patients reported). Implemented in dbench.prospective_campaign.aggregate_funnel (funnel_aggregate.json: 'ladder' block, table entries carry ladder_tier and pooled_ladder).

budget.meaning: frozen hypotheses per (target, fold); each is validated at all four levels with the nulls above (validation cost ~ 4 levels x nulls per hypothesis); measured cost recorded per level in every receipt (ladder_timing_seconds and per-row seconds)
